query_text: 有没有哪家餐馆里面不那么拥挤、坐下来觉得宽敞舒服的？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐馆是否不拥挤、座位空间是否宽裕。
evidence_span: No matter where you are, you do not feel cramped -there's space to breathe
evidence_context: The booth nook is a good location.  No matter where you are, you do not feel cramped -there's space to breathe, and you aren't sitting at those flimsy glass tables that so many restaurants have these days.  A definite plus.  The people who greeted us and sat us were especially welcoming.

query_text: 想找个客人不多、吃饭不用挤来挤去的餐厅，哪里有这样的地方？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明餐厅当时客流是否稀少、是否不拥挤。
evidence_span: There were empty tables around us so the restaurant was not packed.
evidence_context: DO NOT GO! The management and wait staff made us feel incredibly uncomfortable.  Someone will come over every 5 minutes to try to take our plates away even though we were still eating.  It got to a point were several staff members hovered around our table.  We left without finishing our wine.  There were empty tables around us so the restaurant was not packed.

query_text: 求推荐一家不拥挤的餐厅，人多到走不动的地方我真受不了。
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅是否拥挤、顾客和服务员是否有足够的走动空间。
evidence_span: But the restaurant was so crowded. I saw customers even the waiters/waitresses had difficulties to walk through tables.
evidence_context: Definitely love the food and its excellent service. But the restaurant was so crowded. I saw customers even the waiters/waitresses had difficulties to walk through tables.

query_text: 想找一家就餐空间宽松、不会跟邻桌挤在一起的餐馆。
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐馆是否为了塞下太多人而显得拥挤局促。
evidence_span: they try to pack too many people in a small space
evidence_context: Good food, good service, inspiring presentation, but they try to pack too many people in a small space.  I sat right on top of the people next to me, who weren't at my table.  They need to expand, or get rid of a third of the tables.  Because it's usually packed, the former would be the better option.
